component.name: QSSTV-Experimental
component.summary: Amateur radio slow-scan television and digital SSTV (DRM)

description.p: QSSTV-Experimental sends and receives amateur radio slow-scan television (SSTV) pictures and digital SSTV over DRM, using your sound card and optionally a rig-control connection through Hamlib.

It is an independent fork of QSSTV 9.5.11 by Johan Maes, ON4QZ, built on Qt 6. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the original author, and it is a separate application from the original QSSTV, so the two can be installed side by side. Changes from the original include:

ul.li: Sample-rate calibration from WWV time ticks, NTP, or the slant of a received SSTV picture
Decode SSTV from audio files (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC), from the GUI at about 10x real time, or from the command line with qsstv-experimental --batch, headless, with scriptable exit codes
New SSTV modes: JB60, a ~61 s 640*496 color mode, and PD120W, a 16:9 widescreen PD120
Stitched grid images: transmit large pictures as 1x2, 2x1 or 2x2 grids on the larger modes
Gallery multi-select, to delete or send several images to TX
WebP, AVIF and HEIC image formats, with EXIF/HEIF orientation applied on import
Clipboard support: copy images from anywhere, paste into the transmit window or TX stock
DRM Progressive Image Reception: image previews as you receive, improving in quality over time

description.p: The original QSSTV features are kept: Martin, Scottie, Robot, PD and many other SSTV modes, HAMDRM (digital SSTV) receive and transmit, an image gallery, a transmit image editor with templates, and CW and FSK identification.
